title: Creamy Stilton Casserole
description: A rich and comforting casserole filled with creamy sauce and melted stilton cheese, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Butter the casserole dish and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour in the cream, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in the Stilton cheese until melted.
Add the Uruguayan cheese and mix until well combined.
Transfer the sauce to the prepared casserole dish.
Top with additional Stilton cheese if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
